attempts_note: Every --check run on a distinct spec is listed here, in the order it ran. Raw command, exit status and stdout/stderr for each are in attempts-log.jsonl (recorded/, beside this file).

attempts.note: 9-node request+provision draft; gutter bands cp->pgrpc(23 chars)/wapi->q(21) reserved cells on the rank-0 port row and killed two routes: 'no obstacle-safe route for web -> wapi'.
7-node version with 5 label_slot edges; 'no obstacle-safe route for web -> wapi, wapi -> q, q -> db, q -> reg'. Two bands per rank gap is the failure.
FINAL: 6-rank provisioning spine, one banded edge per gap, every source alone in its rank. extent 48x44, crossings 0, labels 5/5, origins 5/5.
6-node boot+heartbeat draft (mch/boot/s3/agent/pub/db), 2 gutter labels, 4 in-gap labels; extent 39x59 — 12 rows past the 47-row target.
8-node draft with label_slot on all 8 edges; 3 bands from mch in one rank gap (plus boot->mch's band): 'no obstacle-safe route for boot -> mch, mch -> agent, mch -> s3'.

FINAL (best available): 5 edges, no gutter bands, single 23-row rank gap for the boot fan. Routes cleanly (crossings 0, labels 5/5, origins 5/5) but extent 52x53 — still 6 rows past the target. Fit defect recorded.
lr two-area fan (10 nodes, 8 edges) with rank pins; 'no obstacle-safe route for wapi -> q' — the inter-area label rows cut the only return corridor.
lr fan with every return edge removed (11 nodes, 8 edges); still 'no obstacle-safe route for agent -> pub' — 8 in-gap labels in one lr channel leave no horizontal lane.
FINAL (best available): tb 2-rank state/heartbeat fan, 5 edges, no bands. extent 80x31 — 3 columns past the target — and 1 label skipped ('register + heartbeat'). Both defects recorded.
lr two-area diagnostics+audit fan (9 nodes, 6 edges); 'no obstacle-safe route for jan -> wapi' (return edge through the label channel).
FINAL: tb, 4 pinned phase ranks, 5 edges (2 banded gaps, 1 in-gap gap, 1 long edge, 1 return edge). extent 54x42, crossings 0, labels 5/5, origins 5/5.
wider 7-edge variant that would also carry web->wapi and pgrpc->db; extent 69x52 (over the target) with 2 bridges and 1 ambiguous label owner, so v4-b was shipped instead.

capability_preflight_probes.note: Not a view candidate: measures an in-gap label in tb (2 nodes, 1 edge, 20-char label, no label_slot). Result: extent 24x30 and the label skipped — a tall rank gap does not guarantee a free cell.
Not a view candidate: same pair with label_slot -> extent 39x12, label placed. Confirms label_slot turns a 23-row gap into a 3-row gap plus a horizontal band.
